gl.rules.title: How it works
gl.rules.1: Pick the man, pick what he does, tap the zone where it happened. You can also drag a shirt onto the pitch.
gl.rules.2: Up to five touches. Select a touch on the pitch to move it, change its verb or take it off.
gl.rules.3: Each touch scores up to four: the man 1, the verb 1, the exact zone 2 or 1 for the zone next door. A man the report does not name is not scored. Extra or missing touches score nothing and lower your quality.
gl.rules.4: Blow the whistle to see your goal, then the report's goal, side by side.
gl.approx: Zones are the report's own words placed on a grid. The archive holds no coordinates or timings, so the replay shows order and place, never speed or exact position.
gl.run.title: Three goals rebuilt
gl.intro.title: Rebuild the goal, touch by touch
gl.intro.body: Read nothing, remember everything: rebuild {m} goals from the club's history on a pitch of zones, then see each one beside the report.
gl.intro.rule1: {min} to {max} touches per goal: who has the ball, what he does, and the zone it happens in.
gl.intro.rule2: One hint per goal, and it costs {cost} point. It only tells you how many touches the report describes.
gl.intro.rule3: Zone practice: the report names areas of the pitch, not exact coordinates, and there is no clock. An unnamed man in the report is not scored.
gl.tier.near: Close. Read it again and rebuild.
gl.result.na: not scored: the report does not name him
